name: Wikimedia Commons
capabilities: Shared freely licensed media repository with a documented MediaWiki API and file-specific licensing; not a blanket public-domain image collection.
licensing: Structured file-namespace data CC0; unstructured site text CC BY-SA; media files have individual description-page licenses and additional terms. Do not use/index files flagged as questionable copyright.
limitations: No current verified item-query examples. Catalog identity and documentation do not establish qualification.
Reading availability, jurisdiction, language, native version identity and machine-use limits remain open.
next_action: Read the supported API contract and permitted query routes, inspect file licensing and revision identity, and exclude questionable-copyright files. Preserve existing access-policy blocks; do not guess alternate endpoints.

analysis_refs.heading: C20 — Educational podcasts, lectures and documentaries
analysis_refs.text:
**Where to start.** Begin with universities, public educational broadcasters and
institutional media producers, following their series/catalog links. In India,
[NPTEL's course catalog](https://nptel.ac.in/courses) provides instructor/course
and institutional discovery leads; investigate official educational broadcaster
and university series alongside it. For international and US material, inspect
university lecture catalogs and public-media learning collections. The
[Internet Archive developer portal](https://archive.org/developers/) documents
metadata tools for archive-hosted media; [Wikimedia Commons API guidance](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:API)
supports another metadata route, with license and exclusion markers to review.
